---
# style: venue style guide name (looked up as paper/style.md, ~/.claude/paper-orchestra/styles/<name>.md, then the plugin's styles/)
style: ml-conference
# cutoff: newest publication month (YYYY-MM) that cited work may have
cutoff: 2024-11
# blind_review: true removes author names and identifying links from the draft
blind_review: true
# language: language the paper is written in
language: English
# profile: usage profile, full or light (controls literature size, critic and review rounds)
profile: full
# max_review_rounds: upper limit on review and revise rounds (optional; when absent it follows the profile's revision rounds)
# hand_edits: keep preserves your manual edits on re-draft, revise lets reviewers rework them
hand_edits: keep
# authors: author names, used only when blind_review is false
authors: []
---
